title: Bell and Visitor
author: Sebastian Dunmore
blurb: Petra Okafor, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
